services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: Which pest do you want to get rid of?

bedbugs.title: Bed bugs
bedbugs.text: They live in beds, upholstered furniture, carpets and under door and window frames. They feed on the blood of people and animals and cause allergies and serious discomfort.

cockroaches.title: Cockroaches
cockroaches.text: They spread germs. They live in cracks, under furniture and bathtubs and behind cabinets, feeding on food, waste, leather goods and paper.

scorpions.title: Scorpions
scorpions.text: Heat-loving creatures that feed on insects. They live in barns and houses, most often in wooden buildings.

services.trustTitle: Trusted by our customers for many years
services.trustText: We treat homes, offices, shops and warehouses. Our specialists work in protective suits with modern equipment.

q1.question: How is pest treatment carried out?
q1.answer: Special equipment turns the product into a fine mist. It reaches the smallest gaps between wallpaper, walls and floorboards — the places where insects hide.

q2.question: Are the products you use dangerous?
q2.answer: The products are safe for people, pets and plants. You only need to air the room for 40 minutes after treatment.

q3.question: How should I prepare my home?
q3.answer: Put away dishes and personal hygiene items. Keep pets in another room during treatment. There is no need to move furniture or appliances.
